_comment: Action playbook (F15). Purely presentational - contributes 0 points and never changes the verdict. Ordered steps, short sentences.

strings.playbook.red.remove: If you already installed {app}: open Settings, then Apps, then {app}, and remove it now.
strings.playbook.red.otp_shared: If you ever shared an OTP or PIN with anyone, call your bank right now and tell them.
strings.playbook.red.check_bank: Check your bank account for any transaction you did not make, and tell your bank.
strings.playbook.red.official_only: Only install {app} from its official Play Store listing.
strings.playbook.red.report: Report it: call 1930, or go to cybercrime.gov.in.
strings.playbook.yellow.official_source: Download this app only from the official Play Store listing, not from a link.
strings.playbook.yellow.check_reviews: Read the reviews and check who published it.
strings.playbook.yellow.ask_someone: If you are not sure, ask someone you trust before installing it.
strings.playbook.green.keep_updated: Keep the app updated from the official store.
strings.playbook.green.still_careful: Do not share OTPs or PINs with anyone, even if an app or caller asks.
